title: com.clodhub/calendar-event
description: One calendar event kept in a records store, in the collection the component's collection setting names (calendarEvents by default), as a records export writes it: the document of a com.clodhub/records-line, dates as {"$date": ISO text}. records-calendar keeps its events so; google-calendar keeps a copy of each event it made in Google Calendar, with Google's event id and calendar id, so records-calendar can take the events over unchanged.

_id.description: The event's id on its calendar, as createEvent returned it: a random UUID from records-calendar (also the iCalendar UID), Google Calendar's event id on a copy google-calendar keeps.

calendar.description: The calendar, as createEvent was given it: a name the owner chose (such as bookings), or a Google calendar id.

start.description: A date, written as a records export writes dates.

end.description: A date, written as a records export writes dates.

timeZone.description: The IANA time zone the event was made in, such as Europe/Madrid.

createdAt.description: A date, written as a records export writes dates.

provider.description: On a copy: the calendar service that holds the event. Absent on records-calendar's own events.
